journal_lines: §oSmelled grain and blood before the field came into view. Something had been working the rows for days.
§aAbandoned field at the plain's edge. Hunter cleared the animals. Woodcutter cleared the overgrowth. Both bags filled.
Rabbits in the wheat, boars at the field margin. Chased both. Took what we chased.
§aThe crop had been standing untended. It waited. §lHarvest§a split between hunt and salvage.
Farmhouse empty, door standing open. The field had not waited for an owner. Neither did we.
Chased animals out of the rows, then came back through what they had left. The field rewarded both jobs.
§aScarecrow with no effect on anything. §oThe whole field smelled like something had been eating it for weeks. We did better.
Long rows, half-stripped. The hunter took what was running. The woodcutter took what was standing. Good split.
